description: AwesomeFee — TRON resources for AI agents. Free. Finds what you need on TRON — e.g. "send USDT without TRX", "buy energy", "TRON RPC node", "events webhook" (English or Russian) — and returns catalogue entries: id, title, description, method, url, parameters (JSON Schema of the body), price, payment (free | x402 | pass), a curl example and what comes back. No q = the whole catalogue. Then call the returned URL yourself with an x402 v2 HTTP client (@x402/fetch, @x402/axios, Python x402): the first call answers 402 with the terms, your client pays in USDC on Base from YOUR wallet and repeats, you get the result. This server never pays and never holds keys.

q.description: What you need, in words, e.g. "send USDT", "купить энергию", "rpc". Omit for the whole catalogue.

name: search
title: AwesomeFee: find TRON products for agents (energy, sending, node, events)
